title: Right unitality from representative normalization
statement: Let Q:C→D and R:E→H be lax monoidal, F:C→E oplax monoidal, S:D→H a functor, and r:QS→FR a natural transformation. Let δ be a tensor comparison natural in its second variable and η:S(1_D)→1_H a unit map. Suppose δ and η obey the tensor and unit representative squares displayed in the Lean statement. If r_X is monic, then δ_{QX,1}(1⊗η)ρ=S(ρ_{QX}).

source.place: Compatibility (3), Right unitality from representative normalization

proof.text: Tensor the unit normalization with r_X. Tensorator naturality and tensor normalization turn one path into the ordinary oplax right-unit law; lax right unitality computes the other. Naturality of r makes the resulting equality the desired equation followed by r_X. Cancel that monomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility (3), tensor and mixed Cartesian squares.

theorem rightUnit_on_representative
    {C D E H : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E] [Category H]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D] [MonoidalCategory E] [MonoidalCategory H]
    (Q : C ⥤ D) [Q.LaxMonoidal] (R : E ⥤ H) [R.LaxMonoidal]
    (F : C ⥤ E) [F.OplaxMonoidal] (S : D ⥤ H)
    (r : Q ⋙ S ⟶ F ⋙ R)
    (δ : ∀ X Y : D, S.obj (X ⊗ Y) ⟶ S.obj X ⊗ S.obj Y)
    (η : S.obj (𝟙_ D) ⟶ 𝟙_ H)
    (hδ : ∀ X {Y Z : D} (f : Y ⟶ Z),
      S.map (X ◁ f) ≫ δ X Z = δ X Y ≫ (S.obj X ◁ S.map f))
    (ht : ∀ X Y : C,
      δ (Q.obj X) (Q.obj Y) ≫ (r.app X ⊗ₘ r.app Y) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ R (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) =
      S.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ Q X Y) ≫ r.app (X ⊗ Y) ≫
        R.map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F X Y))
    (hu : S.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε Q) ≫ r.app (𝟙_ C) ≫
      R.map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η F) = η ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε R)
    (X : C) [Mono (r.app X)] :
    δ (Q.obj X) (𝟙_ D) ≫ (S.obj (Q.obj X) ◁ η) ≫ (ρ_ (S.obj (Q.obj X))).hom =
      S.map (ρ_ (Q.obj X)).hom
